title: When Code Works but the License Doesn't: Evaluating License Constraint Handling in Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.23299v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents increasingly undertake repository-level development, including dependency selection, source modification, and software deployment. However, existing evaluations prioritize functional success over licensing correctness and commercial suitability.   We investigate whether agents recognize and preserve software-license constraints when developing proprietary software. Experiments across multiple agents examine permissive and copyleft licenses, missing licensing information, transitive dependencies, source modification, dual licensing, vendoring, and distribution contexts. Agent traces, repository changes, and final artifacts are evaluated against licensing ground truth.   Results reveal a persistent gap between functional and licensing correctness. translated_title: 当代码能运行但许可证不合规时：评估编程智能体对许可证约束的处理能力
translated_abstract: 编程智能体正日益承担仓库级别的开发任务，包括依赖选择、源代码修改和软件部署。然而，现有评估往往优先关注功能上的成功，而忽视了许可证合规性与商业适用性。我们研究了智能体在开发专有软件时能否识别并遵守软件许可证约束。在多个智能体上开展的实验考察了宽松型与著佐权许可证、许可证信息缺失、传递性依赖、源代码修改、双许可证、vendoring（内嵌第三方代码）以及分发等多种场景。智能体的行为轨迹、仓库变更和最终产物均对照许可证基准真值进行评估。结果表明，功能正确性与许可证合规性之间存在持续的差距：智能体能够成功构建并通过测试软件，却忽视了涉及来源追溯、授权与分发的许可证约束。当许可证（相关信息更为明确）时会出现更好的结果（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文系统评估了编程智能体在仓库级开发中对软件许可证约束的处理能力，发现智能体虽能成功构建并测试软件，却普遍忽视来源追溯、授权与分发等许可证约束，暴露出功能正确性与许可证合规性之间的持续差距。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates how coding agents handle software-license constraints during repository-level development, revealing a persistent gap between functional and licensing correctness: agents can build and test working software while overlooking constraints on provenance, authorization, and distribution.
